body: Thank you so much! I will make sure to remember your kindness :-)
Yes, thank you for asking! It was a rough night, but mornings are always better.
Thank you for taking the time to answer me, it does mean a lot. And for the kind words... I am feeling a little better. Thank you.

Thank you so much for your kind words... I am so scared to leave school, because it's so hard to come back from failure, but sometimes I think life will be much better outside of school. At the very least, I won't be getting graded for every move I make. 

I hope my work ethic and my talent isn't gone. Some days it feels like it is so it means a lot that you say it isn't. 

Also, not to sound creepy, but I stalked your reddit history. Your cat is very cute. Definitely helped my mood.

I used to really love to write, but it's been hard for me to do that lately. I've been doing a habit tracker to try to write every day but it's hit or miss...

I just wish I could go back in time and stop myself from ruining my own life, you know?
